name: Route 49: 20 % more weekday trips, demand held fixed
assumptions: Baseline: route 49 on weekdays in the full matched window (23 Nov 2025 – 31 Jul 2026), from recorded rides and the timetables that applied on the same days.
Demand is held fixed: recorded rides stay as they were, so adding service does not add riders.
Change 1: on route 49, scheduled trips change by +20 %.
Each trip keeps the baseline's mean duration (route 49: 85.8 minutes), so trip-hours change in proportion to trips.

Re-ranked with the usual rules: a route needs at least 20 observed days of this day type, ties share a rank, and routes below that stay unranked with their reason. Route groups are the frozen version fitted on the development period.
This is conditional planning arithmetic, not a forecast. It does not show reduced crowding, a ridership gain or a timetable that could actually be run.
Running-time effects (congestion, departure times, direction mix) are not modelled: each changed trip is assumed to take the baseline's mean time.

name: Lower-demand group: rides assumed 15 % lower on weekdays
assumptions: Baseline: the route group “Lower-demand routes, often with limited or no weekend service” (56 routes) on weekdays in the full matched window (23 Nov 2025 – 31 Jul 2026), from recorded rides and the timetables that applied on the same days.
Scenario assumption: rides fall by 15 % on the baseline routes. This is assumed demand, not a prediction; the recorded rides are kept alongside.
Every other route keeps its demand.

Re-ranked with the usual rules: a route needs at least 20 observed days of this day type, ties share a rank, and routes below that stay unranked with their reason. Route groups are the frozen version fitted on the development period.
This is conditional planning arithmetic, not a forecast. It does not show reduced crowding, a ridership gain or a timetable that could actually be run.
Running-time effects (congestion, departure times, direction mix) are not modelled: each changed trip is assumed to take the baseline's mean time.

name: Route 1: add 40 Sunday trips where there is no Sunday service
assumptions: Baseline: route 1 on Sundays and holidays in the full matched window (23 Nov 2025 – 31 Jul 2026), from recorded rides and the timetables that applied on the same days.
Demand is held fixed: recorded rides stay as they were, so adding service does not add riders.
Change 1: on route 1, scheduled trips are set to 40 per day.
Route 1: no recorded rides on days without service, so demand there is unknown; trip-hours need a stated value per day.
